# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `viafrei-api config docs` from internal/runtime/config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tunable of the service is one key below. Sources are layered: the built-in default, then an optional YAML file (path in `VFAPI_CONFIG_FILE`), then environment variables. The service refuses to start on an unknown key, an unknown variable with the prefix, a value out of bounds or a broken cross-field rule, and lists every violation. Secrets are read only from the environment or from a file named by the `_FILE` variant (one of the two, never both), never from the YAML file, and are never printed. Exit status on a configuration error: 78.

Cross-field rules: `db.pool_min` ≤ `db.pool_max`; `deadline.reserve` < `deadline.request`; `health.ready_timeout` ≤ `deadline.request`; `db.statement_timeout_floor` < `deadline.request` − `deadline.reserve`; `compose.part_deadline` × the number of overview parts ≤ `deadline.request` − `deadline.reserve`; the sum of `tiers.*.reserved`, `tiers.bulk.max_inflight` and `tiers.per_key_inflight` are each ≤ `db.pool_max`; every `tiers.*.queue_max_wait` < `deadline.request`.

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server.listen_addr` | `VFAPI_SERVER_LISTEN_ADDR` | string | `localhost:8080` | host:port | Address of the public listener, host:port. Behind the TLS edge in production. |
| `server.public_base_url` | `VFAPI_SERVER_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | string | `https://api.viafrei.de` | absolute URL; starts with https:// | Absolute base URL used in links, problem type URIs and the OpenAPI servers entry. https only. |
| `server.read_header_timeout` | `VFAPI_SERVER_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT` | duration | `2s` | 100ms to 300s | Time allowed to read the request headers. |
| `server.read_timeout` | `VFAPI_SERVER_READ_TIMEOUT` | duration | `5s` | 100ms to 300s | Time allowed to read the whole request. |
| `server.write_timeout` | `VFAPI_SERVER_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `5s` | 100ms to 300s | Time allowed to write the response. |
| `server.idle_timeout` | `VFAPI_SERVER_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `60s` | 100ms to 300s | Time an idle keep-alive connection is kept open. |
| `server.max_header_bytes` | `VFAPI_SERVER_MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | int | `16384` | 4096 to 1048576 | Largest accepted request header block, in bytes (431 above). |
| `server.max_uri_bytes` | `VFAPI_SERVER_MAX_URI_BYTES` | int | `8192` | 2048 to 65536 | Longest accepted request URI, in bytes (414 above). |
| `server.shutdown_grace` | `VFAPI_SERVER_SHUTDOWN_GRACE` | duration | `10s` | 1s to 60s | Time in-flight requests get to finish on shutdown; the final metering flush runs after it. |
| `server.trusted_proxies` | `VFAPI_SERVER_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | list | empty | CIDR list | Networks (CIDR) of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is believed; the client address is then the nearest address in that header outside these networks. Empty: the immediate peer is the client (RATE-001). Comma-separated in the environment. |
| `http.hsts_max_age` | `VFAPI_HTTP_HSTS_MAX_AGE` | duration | `8760h` | 0s to 17520h | max-age of Strict-Transport-Security on every answer, sent in whole seconds; 0s sends max-age=0, which tells browsers to forget the policy. |
| `db.url` | `VFAPI_DB_URL` or `VFAPI_DB_URL_FILE` | secret | secret, no default | — | Connection URL of the service's read-only role. Required to serve. Secret: environment or *_FILE only. |
| `db.pool_max` | `VFAPI_DB_POOL_MAX` | int | `4` | 1 to 16 | Largest number of pooled connections. |
| `db.pool_min` | `VFAPI_DB_POOL_MIN` | int | `1` | 0 to 16 | Connections kept open when idle. At most pool_max. |
| `db.connect_timeout` | `VFAPI_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | duration | `2s` | 100ms to 30s | Time allowed to open one connection. |
| `db.max_conn_lifetime` | `VFAPI_DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME` | duration | `30m` | 1m to 24h | A connection older than this is closed after use. |
| `db.max_conn_idle` | `VFAPI_DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE` | duration | `5m` | 10s to 24h | An idle connection older than this is closed. |
| `db.statement_timeout_floor` | `VFAPI_DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_FLOOR` | duration | `50ms` | 10ms to 1s | Smallest useful remaining budget; below it a read is refused without touching storage. |
| `db.cancel_grace` | `VFAPI_DB_CANCEL_GRACE` | duration | `100ms` | 10ms to 1s | Time a cancel request gets to land before the connection is abandoned. |
| `db.application_name` | `VFAPI_DB_APPLICATION_NAME` | string | `viafrei-api` | at most 63 characters | application_name reported to the database. |
| `deadline.request` | `VFAPI_DEADLINE_REQUEST` | duration | `2s` | 200ms to 2s | Hard deadline of every request (NFR-PERF-001). |
| `deadline.reserve` | `VFAPI_DEADLINE_RESERVE` | duration | `50ms` | 0s to 500ms | Margin kept back from the deadline when the statement timeout is set. Less than deadline.request. |
| `contract.expected` | `VFAPI_CONTRACT_EXPECTED` | string | empty | major.minor | Read-contract version (major.minor) this instance requires; empty means the version built in. Readiness fails on another major or an older minor. |
| `health.ready_timeout` | `VFAPI_HEALTH_READY_TIMEOUT` | duration | `500ms` | 50ms to 2s | Time the readiness probe gives storage to answer. At most deadline.request. |
| `health.probe_timeout` | `VFAPI_HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `1s` | 100ms to 10s | Time the healthcheck subcommand waits for /healthz. |
| `log.level` | `VFAPI_LOG_LEVEL` | string | `info` | one of debug, info, warn, error | Lowest level written: debug, info, warn or error. |
| `log.format` | `VFAPI_LOG_FORMAT` | string | `json` | one of json, text | Log line format on standard output: json or text. |
| `docs.enabled` | `VFAPI_DOCS_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | — | Serve the OpenAPI document at /v1/openapi.json and /openapi.json. |
| `endpoints.disabled` | `VFAPI_ENDPOINTS_DISABLED` | list | empty | — | Operation ids switched off: they answer 404 feature-disabled and leave the OpenAPI document. Comma-separated in the environment. |
| `access.url` | `VFAPI_ACCESS_URL` or `VFAPI_ACCESS_URL_FILE` | secret | secret, no default | — | Connection URL of the API's own access-store role. Without it every keyed operation answers 404 feature-disabled. Secret: environment or *_FILE only. |
| `access.pool_max` | `VFAPI_ACCESS_POOL_MAX` | int | `2` | 1 to 8 | Largest number of pooled access-store connections. |
| `auth.environment` | `VFAPI_AUTH_ENVIRONMENT` | string | `live` | one of live, test | Which keys this instance accepts: live (production) or test (sandbox). A key of the other environment is invalid here (SEC-004). |
| `auth.key_prefix_live` | `VFAPI_AUTH_KEY_PREFIX_LIVE` | string | `vf_live_` | key_prefix | Prefix of a production key: two groups of 1 to 5 lowercase letters or digits, each closed by an underscore. |
| `auth.key_prefix_test` | `VFAPI_AUTH_KEY_PREFIX_TEST` | string | `vf_test_` | key_prefix | Prefix of a sandbox key, in the same form. Differs from auth.key_prefix_live. |
| `auth.pepper` | `VFAPI_AUTH_PEPPER` or `VFAPI_AUTH_PEPPER_FILE` | secret | secret, no default | — | Server-side MAC pepper, at least 32 bytes. Required with access.url. Held outside the access store (SEC-010). Secret: environment or *_FILE only. |
| `auth.pepper_previous` | `VFAPI_AUTH_PEPPER_PREVIOUS` or `VFAPI_AUTH_PEPPER_PREVIOUS_FILE` | secret | secret, no default | — | The previous pepper during a pepper rotation: a key that matches under it is re-MACed under auth.pepper on first use (SEC-011). At least 32 bytes when set. |
| `auth.key_cache_ttl` | `VFAPI_AUTH_KEY_CACHE_TTL` | duration | `60s` | 1s to 10m | How long a key read from the access store is kept in memory. A plan change or a revocation is seen at the latest after this time (SEC-022). |
| `auth.negative_cache_ttl` | `VFAPI_AUTH_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL` | duration | `10s` | 0s to 5m | How long an unknown key id is remembered as unknown, to blunt floods of random keys (SEC-050). 0s turns it off. |
| `auth.key_cache_size` | `VFAPI_AUTH_KEY_CACHE_SIZE` | int | `10000` | 10 to 1000000 | Largest number of key ids held in the key cache, known and unknown together; when full, expired entries are dropped first, then any one. |
| `auth.rotation_overlap` | `VFAPI_AUTH_ROTATION_OVERLAP` | duration | `168h` | 0s to 720h | How long the previous secret stays valid after a rotation (SEC-041). |
| `auth.default_expiry` | `VFAPI_AUTH_DEFAULT_EXPIRY` | duration | `8760h` | 24h to 26280h | Lifetime of a key issued without an explicit expiry (SEC-040). An explicit expiry is held to 26280h (1 095 days) too. |
| `auth.revocation_propagation` | `VFAPI_AUTH_REVOCATION_PROPAGATION` | duration | `5s` | 1s to 60s | Interval at which the service asks the access store for keys changed since its last look and drops them from its cache (SEC-042). At most auth.key_cache_ttl. |
| `auth.expiry_warning_days` | `VFAPI_AUTH_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS` | int | `14` | 0 to 90 | Days before expiry from which an answer carries the key_expiring warning (SEC-043). 0 turns the warning off. |
| `auth.failure_limit` | `VFAPI_AUTH_FAILURE_LIMIT` | int | `10` | 1 to 1000 | Authentication failures one client address may have per auth.failure_window before it is answered 429 rate-limited (SEC-052). |
| `auth.failure_window` | `VFAPI_AUTH_FAILURE_WINDOW` | duration | `1m` | 1s to 1h | The window auth.failure_limit counts in. |
| `auth.failure_track_size` | `VFAPI_AUTH_FAILURE_TRACK_SIZE` | int | `10000` | 10 to 1000000 | Largest number of client addresses whose failures are counted at once; when full, ended windows are dropped first, then any one. |
| `audit.retention_days` | `VFAPI_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | int | `395` | 30 to 1825 | Days an audit record is kept; keys prune removes older ones (SEC-045). |
| `sources.disabled` | `VFAPI_SOURCES_DISABLED` | list | empty | — | Source families the licence gate always denies, whatever the plan (SEC-030). Comma-separated in the environment. |
| `geo.default_radius_m` | `VFAPI_GEO_DEFAULT_RADIUS_M` | int | `2000` | 1 to 50000 | Search radius in metres when a near search names none. At most the radius_m maximum of the interface, 50000. |
| `pagination.default_limit` | `VFAPI_PAGINATION_DEFAULT_LIMIT` | int | `20` | 1 to 100 | Items a list answer returns when the request names no limit (ENV-021). At most the limit maximum of the interface, 100. |
| `charging.status_max_age` | `VFAPI_CHARGING_STATUS_MAX_AGE` | duration | `30m` | 1m to 24h | How old a charge point's reported state may be and still count; an older one, or one older than its family's freshness threshold, is answered as stale and not counted as available. The default is the MCP capability's own limit, 30 minutes. The parity harness runs on its own defaults, and its question charging-status-age-limit is asked 38 minutes after a report, so it fails only when the default is raised above 38 minutes. |
| `compose.part_deadline` | `VFAPI_COMPOSE_PART_DEADLINE` | duration | `800ms` | 100ms to 2s | Sub-deadline of each part of a composed answer (FR-BRIEF-003); a part that does not finish in it is reported timeout. The parts run one after the other, so this times the number of parts must not exceed deadline.request minus deadline.reserve. |
| `compose.per_part_limit` | `VFAPI_COMPOSE_PER_PART_LIMIT` | int | `5` | 1 to 20 | Items per part of a composed answer when the request names no per_part_limit. |
| `roads.ended_retention_h` | `VFAPI_ROADS_ENDED_RETENTION_H` | int | `24` | 1 to 168 | Hours an ended road situation still answers 200 on its own operation, with validity.until in the past; after that it answers 404 not-found (Spec: Endpoints, Roads, section 6). |
| `ratelimit.anon_rps` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_ANON_RPS` | int | `1` | 0 to 100 | Requests per second one client address may make without presenting a key (service endpoints and keyless requests), as a token bucket (RATE-001, SEC-051). 0 switches the per-address limit off. |
| `ratelimit.anon_burst` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_ANON_BURST` | int | `5` | 1 to 1000 | Burst of the per-address token bucket: requests a client address may make at once before ratelimit.anon_rps applies. |
| `ratelimit.headers` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` | bool | `true` | — | Send RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit on every keyed answer (RATE-006). |
| `ratelimit.ip_state_ttl` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_IP_STATE_TTL` | duration | `10m` | 1m to 60m | How long the state of an idle client address is kept; it is held in memory only and never stored (RATE-015). |
| `ratelimit.ip_track_size` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_IP_TRACK_SIZE` | int | `100000` | 100 to 10000000 | Largest number of client addresses tracked at once; when full, idle entries are dropped first, then the least recently seen. |
| `ratelimit.ipv6_prefix` | `VFAPI_RATELIMIT_IPV6_PREFIX` | int | `64` | 32 to 128 | Prefix length an IPv6 client address is counted by: every address inside one such prefix shares one per-address bucket, since one subscriber is routinely given a whole /64 (RATE-001). 128 counts each address alone. |
| `quota.reset_tz` | `VFAPI_QUOTA_RESET_TZ` | string | `Europe/Berlin` | IANA time zone | Time zone whose midnight resets the daily quota and whose first of the month resets the monthly quota (RATE-003). |
| `tiers.critical.reserved` | `VFAPI_TIERS_CRITICAL_RESERVED` | int | `1` | 0 to 16 | Permits kept for the critical tier that lower tiers cannot use (RATE-009). |
| `tiers.critical.queue_len` | `VFAPI_TIERS_CRITICAL_QUEUE_LEN` | int | `32` | 0 to 1024 | Critical requests that may wait for a permit; one more is shed. |
| `tiers.critical.queue_max_wait` | `VFAPI_TIERS_CRITICAL_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT` | duration | `800ms` | 0s to 2s | Longest time a critical request waits for a permit before it is shed. Less than deadline.request. |
| `tiers.standard.reserved` | `VFAPI_TIERS_STANDARD_RESERVED` | int | `0` | 0 to 16 | Permits kept for the standard tier (and above) that the bulk tier cannot use. |
| `tiers.standard.queue_len` | `VFAPI_TIERS_STANDARD_QUEUE_LEN` | int | `32` | 0 to 1024 | Standard requests that may wait for a permit; one more is shed. |
| `tiers.standard.queue_max_wait` | `VFAPI_TIERS_STANDARD_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT` | duration | `400ms` | 0s to 2s | Longest time a standard request waits for a permit before it is shed. Less than deadline.request. |
| `tiers.bulk.reserved` | `VFAPI_TIERS_BULK_RESERVED` | int | `0` | 0 to 16 | Permits reserved for the bulk tier. No tier is below it, so they keep nothing from anyone; they count against db.pool_max only. |
| `tiers.bulk.queue_len` | `VFAPI_TIERS_BULK_QUEUE_LEN` | int | `4` | 0 to 1024 | Bulk requests that may wait for a permit; one more is shed. |
| `tiers.bulk.queue_max_wait` | `VFAPI_TIERS_BULK_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT` | duration | `200ms` | 0s to 2s | Longest time a bulk request waits for a permit before it is shed. Less than deadline.request. |
| `tiers.bulk.max_inflight` | `VFAPI_TIERS_BULK_MAX_INFLIGHT` | int | `1` | 0 to 16 | Permits the bulk tier may hold at once, however many are free (RATE-009). 0 keeps bulk out of storage. At most db.pool_max. |
| `tiers.per_key_inflight` | `VFAPI_TIERS_PER_KEY_INFLIGHT` | int | `4` | 1 to 16 | Permits one key may hold at once (RATE-016). At most db.pool_max. |
| `admission.aging_after` | `VFAPI_ADMISSION_AGING_AFTER` | duration | `500ms` | 0s to 2s | A waiter older than this is promoted one tier, so no tier starves (RATE-010). 0s promotes every waiter at once. |
| `admission.ewma_alpha` | `VFAPI_ADMISSION_EWMA_ALPHA` | float | `0.2` | 0.01 to 1 | Weight of the newest storage service time in the moving average the wait estimate uses (RATE-011). |
| `admission.shed_status` | `VFAPI_ADMISSION_SHED_STATUS` | int | `429` | one of 429, 503 | HTTP status of an overloaded refusal: 429 or 503. The problem type is overloaded either way, with Retry-After. |
| `metering.flush_interval` | `VFAPI_METERING_FLUSH_INTERVAL` | duration | `30s` | 5s to 5m | Interval of the batched usage write to the access store. A crash loses at most one interval of counts; one more flush runs on shutdown. |
| `metering.max_keys_buffered` | `VFAPI_METERING_MAX_KEYS_BUFFERED` | int | `100000` | 100 to 1000000 | Largest number of (key, hour, operation) counters held between flushes; the counts of a new counter beyond it are dropped and the drop is logged. |
| `metering.write_timeout` | `VFAPI_METERING_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | duration | `1s` | 100ms to 10s | Deadline of one usage write; a failed write keeps its counts for the next flush. |
| `metering.retention_days` | `VFAPI_METERING_RETENTION_DAYS` | int | `400` | 30 to 1825 | Days a usage record is kept; keys prune removes older ones. |
